player_prompt.intro:
Mwaiseni ku Frozen Lake!

Mwenu mwakonka umo 'P' pa gridi.
Simbo za gridi:
  ' ' = Useya wa barafu (mwaiseni ukutemwa)
  'H' = Shima (ukalamba na ulenge!
  'G' = Golide (fikeni pano mukwine!
  'P' = Mwenu mwakonka sasa

Mikakati iliyomo: juu, chini, kushoto, kulia (nangu w, a, s, d)
Lembeni mkakati wenu mwakonka: [up], [down], [left], [right] nangu [w], [a], [s], [d]

Lengo: Endeni ukutemwa kufuma mwanzo (juu-kushoto) mpaka golide (chini-kulia) bila kukalamba shimwa!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mfumo wa mkakati si wakweli. Tumia [up], [down], [left], [right] nangu [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Icitendekelo ca '{action}'. Ulebomfya up, down, left, right nelyo w, a, s, d.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Mwaliponene mu cimbulu! Umulwi wapwa. Mwapwishishe {pct}% ya lwendo lwa kuya ku cipao.
outcome.turn_limit: Mwafika pa mpelo ya kuputulako! Umulwi wapwa. Mwalipwisha {pct}% wa lwendo lwa kuya ku buyo.
